title: Wire startup-gate and 2000ms susi-conformance budget into release-qualify and verify_tag
goal: Close the Step 1 acceptance gap in docs/step1-acceptance.md by running Susi's existing startup-gate (`startup` gate) and 2000 ms host-contract conformance suite (`conformance` gate via susi-conformance --max-ms 2000 --susi-bin) inside xtask/src/bin/release-qualify.rs and enforcing both in xtask/src/release_qualification.rs (`verify_tag` / push-policy) for releases after v0.21.66 while preserving historical tag compatibility.

results.tests: release-qualify bin 36 passed, startup-gate bin 12 passed, distilled_release_promotion 12 passed, native_push_policy 17 passed, registry_environment_isolation 3 passed, release_only_branch 6 passed, release_records 5 passed, task_records 3 passed, core_docs_promise_no_ui_or_plugins 5 passed, clippy --workspace --all-targets 0 warnings

reuse.reason: Reused Susi Core's existing xtask startup-gate binary (`susi-startup-gate-v2`), susi-conformance CLI (`--max-ms 2000 --susi-bin --json`), and susi_paths::test_env::isolate_home directly inside release-qualify and verify_tag with zero new dependencies.
reuse.searched: Searched intellibitz/susi xtask/src/bin/{release-qualify.rs,startup-gate.rs,installed-upgrade.rs,local-channel.rs}, xtask/src/{release_qualification.rs,push_policy.rs}, crates/susi-conformance/src/{bin/susi-conformance.rs,lib.rs}, crates/susi-paths/src/test_env.rs, xtask/tests/{distilled_release_promotion.rs,native_push_policy.rs,registry_environment_isolation.rs}, intellibitz/susi-commercial-apps workflow qualification runners, Apache-2.0 conformance harnesses, and the locked Cargo dependency graph; Susi Core already ships both startup-gate and susi-conformance.
